purpose: Test whether the successful offline future-route teacher can be predicted from current marker geometry plus causal past-flow anchors without source identity or future frames at inference.

target.name: offline_future_trace_intrusion_score
target.source: r7.55 per-frame mean of three future horizons

channels: three causal anchor x/y coordinates and anchor-to-expanded-marker distances
current detection count and nearfield accepted count
current maximum bottom, area, width and height
current minimum center distance and left/right detection counts

probe.regressor: weighted ridge with train-fold standardization and intercept
probe.source_weighting: each training source has equal total weight

gate.strict_event_label_separation: minimum positive event prediction must exceed maximum negative event prediction
